description: Agent Education: submit a transcript as issued with the grade reports or student record behind it: the transcript with its institution, student, student id, the day issued, each course with its id, code, title, term, credits and grade as printed, the total credits it prints and the GPA as printed; and optionally the student record with its institution, student, student id, each course with the same fields, its credit total, its GPA and the points it gives each grade. The signed report gives the transcript and the record, the courses matched, the printed courses the record does not show, the recorded courses left off, the courses printed under another term and the titles printed otherwise, the grades read with those printed unlike the record, the credits printed unlike the record with the printed total against its own courses and the record’s total, and the printed GPA against the record’s GPA or the GPA recomputed from the record’s grade points, and counts them, and names a discrepant transcript: a grade printed unlike the record, credits printed unlike the record, a printed course the record does not show, a course printed under another term and a GPA unlike the record’s; then a recorded course left off, a title printed otherwise, a credit total unlike its courses or the record and a student name or id unlike the record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No student record, a printed course with no code, a grade or credits on one side only, a printed GPA that is not a number, or a record with no GPA and no grade points leaves the transcript unverified. Courses meet by code and term, codes by their letters and digits, terms with season and year in either order, and a printed GPA reads to the decimals it prints, rounded or cut. This reads a student’s transcript against the student record: wever_meeting-brief reads a meeting transcript for decisions and action items, which shares only the word, and wever_learning-report-check reads an agent’s learning report against its lesson records, while the transcript check reads courses, grades, credits and the GPA as printed against the record behind them. Verdict edu_transcript_discrepant, edu_transcript_partial, edu_transcript_unverified or edu_transcript_faithful. POST /api/edu-transcript-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.
